title: Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards Enrollment Eligibility Standard
content:
Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards is open to businesses on a pro customer profile, and a business holds at most one ProBuild Rewards membership.

## Standard

1. **One membership.** A business holds at most one ProBuild Rewards membership, that is, no more than 1 membership per business. A pro customer profile with a membership in status pending verification, active or suspended cannot enroll again.
2. **Pro profiles only.** Only a pro customer profile may enroll; a consumer profile is not eligible.
3. **After closure.** A closed membership may be replaced by a new enrollment, which starts at ProBuild Member with no points carried over.

## Basis of judgement

Both conditions are judged before the enrollment is made, from the company's own records rather than from the caller's account of them:

- the customer type recorded on the customer profile that is to enroll (pro or consumer); and
- the status of every ProBuild Rewards membership recorded under that same customer profile.

A membership recorded under a different customer profile is not a membership of the profile that is enrolling.

## Decision table

| Customer type on the profile | ProBuild Rewards memberships already recorded under that profile | Outcome under this standard |
|---|---|---|
| consumer | any | not eligible to enroll |
| pro | one in status pending verification | cannot enroll again |
| pro | one in status active | cannot enroll again |
| pro | one in status suspended | cannot enroll again |
| pro | closed memberships only | may enroll anew; the new membership starts at ProBuild Member with no points carried over |
| pro | none | neither restriction of this standard bars the enrollment |

## Hypothetical illustration

A business's earlier membership was closed while 8000 points stood unredeemed. The business, still on a pro customer profile with no other membership, enrolls again. The new membership starts at ProBuild Member, whatever tier the closed membership had held, and none of the 8000 points is carried over to it.
